resources.string: Your data file is from a version this app build cannot read. Workeeper has not opened it in this launch. Please update the app, or try to export a raw recovery copy.
A raw recovery copy is not available. You can still report the issue or, for an interrupted restore, check whether it is safe to continue.
The raw recovery copy could not be prepared for sharing. Free some storage and try again.
The diagnostic file could not be prepared or shared. You can retry without leaving this screen.

A backup restore was interrupted, so Workeeper cannot determine whether this device contains your earlier data or the restored data. You can export a raw copy, report the issue, or check the current database and choose whether to continue.

The database passed integrity and version checks, but Workeeper still cannot determine whether the interrupted restore completed. Continuing accepts the data currently on this device and discards the interrupted restore record. The app will restart.
This interrupted restore is no longer owned by this recovery screen. Restart Workeeper and try again.
The current database file is missing. Continuing is unavailable.
The current database did not pass the full integrity check. Continuing is unavailable; keep the recovery record and report the issue.
This Workeeper version cannot safely open the database schema currently on the device.
The database could not be checked. Free some storage if needed, then try again or report the issue.
The recovery record could not be updated, so Workeeper did not continue. Try again.
